closure_patch.review: REVIEW.md top (R5, CHANGES_REQUESTED with two fail-closed conditions only)
closure_patch.p0_write_intents: A missing, unreadable, wrong-schema or null write-intent count refuses. A confirmed integer is used; a ledger that provably predates the journal is verified in its own terms (unknown purchase outcomes, SAVE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN events, active unknown-write alerts, active UPDATE_RESULT_UNCONFIRMED holds that name the order) and accepted only when no unknown write is unprotected or unattributable. Holds are read, never cleared. Report schema 4 carries write_intent_state and the legacy_unknown_write audit record.
closure_patch.p0_process_state: Fail-closed process enumeration in both scripts (Get-CimInstance -ErrorAction Stop; an unreadable ExecutablePath is unproven, not 'not running'). Unproven refuses at the database gate, at installer gate 7 and again immediately before the first Move-Item; nothing moves on an unproven state.
closure_patch.negative_tests_first: 11 new offline gate cases; on the pre-patch scripts 4 x 'passed but should have refused' and 5 x 'refused for the wrong reason'; after the patch the harness is green.

superseded_build.note: R5 build before the closure patch; its evidence is preserved as *-pre-p0 and it must not be installed as this candidate
